mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines by >0.2pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and declines in industrial production (INDPRO) indicate demand surges without supply response, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days due to inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS rises and INDPRO falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) generates negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as policy tightening reduces equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) consistently signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth above 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts exceeding 1.5% signals strengthening housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 0.5% monthly) indicates expanding manufacturing activity and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), strong retail sales (RSAFS rise) signal robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS rises and GDPC1 growth > 2.0%.
